notes: The prompt is a 3D labyrinth whose entire challenge is reading the structure and working out the route to the final exit, which is Puzzle by way of the maze row rather than any exploration genre — most of the text is a compliance statement, and the one gameplay sentence is wayfinding. puzzle-maze is the shape and it carries P6, which is never overridden: an image model cannot guarantee a solvable maze with a reachable exit, so the topology has to be valid by construction. I took the Maze / Labyrinth preset but dropped its collectible-nodes, since the author describes pure navigation with nothing to gather and adding keys would change the game; path-loop stays because the author asked for extensive branching paths and it keeps a wrong turn from becoming long backtracking. With no user to ask, I read the author's clean abstract geometric walls and few-minute solve as a compact, well-lit maze, and let the shape's guaranteed exit be the place the run ends rather than adding a separate goal marker.
